name: Postbeam
description:
Postbeam connects Claude to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat.

Once connected with your Postbeam account, Claude works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask Claude to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside Claude, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, Claude can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:

_published_faq.name: How do I add Postbeam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Postbeam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.postbeam.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Postbeam MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Postbeam provides these MCP tools: approve_post, create_draft, get_analytics, get_post, get_post_analytics, get_training, list_accounts, list_posted_posts, list_posts, schedule_post, update_draft, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Postbeam?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Postbeam in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Postbeam requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Postbeam is developed by Postbeam. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
